message.content: Li Hua asked Jennifer Moore for tips on dealing with muscle soreness after her workout session in 20261008_14:00. Specifically, she mentioned that she was feeling sore after their bench press session. Jennifer provided several strategies to help with muscle soreness, including staying hydrated, engaging in light activities like walking or gentle yoga, spending time stretching muscles post-workout, using a foam roller on sore spots, and resting adequately.
